source: Bambu PETG Basic Technical Data Sheet V2.0; XY Young's modulus 1460 +/-190 MPa. Sensitivity endpoints use published Z Young's modulus and XY bending modulus; they are not a statistical confidence interval or an orthotropic constitutive model.
specimen_caveat: Datasheet specimens were annealed and dried at 65 C for 8 hours. Printed clip properties and creep are not established by these figures.
